model.sde_build: cmake -G "Unix Makefiles" -DTOFINO=ON -DGRPC=ON -DBFRT=ON -DTHRIFT-*=OFF -DKERNEL-MODULES=OFF -DSWITCH=OFF -DBF-DIAGS=OFF -DBUILD_MODEL=OFF -DTCMALLOC=OFF -DBF-PYTHON=OFF; pkgsrc/p4-compilers/CMakeLists.txt replaced by a stub in the scratch clone (compiler built separately)

phase_T_meta.scope: single-pipe candidate, phase T: timing D4 configured, READ held and released, response padded

limits: tofino-model is functional only: its clock is not wall time; hold durations are not timing evidence
dp8/dp10 MAC-near loopback emulated by the driver (frames emitted on the port written back into it); hardware loops them in the MAC
tbl_params read_len reads back 0 under 9.13.4 (dead parameter); the driver enabled pktgen only because that was the sole failing setup check
model default $PORT entries removed before setup (the setup expects a cold switch)
bf-p4c 9.13.4 and this open-source SDE, not the switch SDE 9.13.2
